title: Ultra Gooey Jamaican Yeast Casserole
description: A yeasty, gooey, and energizing Jamaican dish featuring a rich dashi extract, this casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner and is gluten-free friendly, served in individual mini cocottes. It combines the bold flavors of Jamaica with the comfort of a warm casserole.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, combine the yeast, dashi extract, and 1 cup of warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Let the yeast mixture sit for 5 minutes, until it becomes frothy.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, brown sugar, and salt.
Add the melted butter, coconut milk, and yeast mixture to the dry ingredients, stirring until a sticky dough forms.
Fold in the diced scotch bonnet peppers.
Divide the dough evenly among 6 individual mini cocottes.
Bake the casseroles for 25 minutes, until they are golden brown and set.
Remove the casseroles from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
